notes: checkJavaOnPath runs `/usr/bin/which java` on a background queue; a non-empty trimmed stdout sets `.found(path:)` (line 1345). Line 1346-1348 only overwrites the preference field's `javaPath` binding if it was already empty when the check ran -- an explicit `if self.javaPath...isEmpty` guard, not an unconditional overwrite, so a user-entered custom path is never clobbered by this check (see the companion not-found case's counterpart, which confirms the field is left alone on failure too).
